summary: SAMEIET INNHERREDSGÅRDEN (org. no. 898 206 262) is a condominium (ESEK) based in Trondheim, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2012-04-07. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 97.001 (Aktiviteter i borettslag og boligsameier); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 1.5 m and net income was NOK 439 328. Board chair: Sondre Øverås.
